description: This file defines API routes for managing menus and menu items in a food delivery platform, utilizing FastAPI's router and JWT authorization. It includes endpoints for creating menus, adding menu items, listing all menus, and fetching menu items for a specific restaurant.

methods.name: create_menu(restaurant_id: int, name: str, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Creates a new menu for a restaurant, assigns a unique ID, and links it to the restaurant.

methods.name: add_menu_item(item: MenuItemCreate, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Adds a new menu item to an existing menu, assigning a unique ID.

methods.name: list_all_menus()
methods.description: Returns a list of all menus.

methods.name: get_menu_items_for_restaurant(restaurant_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all menu items associated with a specific restaurant.

calls: list(item for item in menu_items.values() if item.menu_id in rest_menu_ids)

ctags.name: create_menu
ctags.pattern: /^def create_menu(restaurant_id: int, name: str, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends()):$/
ctags.signature: (restaurant_id: int, name: str, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
